name: Spicy Salmon Cakes with Yogurt & Crunchy Veggie-Cilantro Salad

instructions.primary_message: Drain salmon, place in a large bowl, and flake with a fork.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 (213 g) cans wild pink salmon, traditional style

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince onion; add to the bowl with the salmon.
Add eggs, flour, and spices to the bowl; stir until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 eggs
⅓ cup all-purpose flour
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp cayenne pepper
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a ¼-cup measure, form the salmon mixture into ½-inch thick patties; place on a platter.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add fritters and cook until golden brown and crispy, 3-4 minutes per side; transfer to a paper towel-lined plate.
While the patties are cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice limes into another large bowl.
Add oil and spices to the bowl with the lime; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers into thin strips; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim cucumbers, cut crosswise into 3-inch portions, then cut each portion lengthwise into thin sticks. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocados. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out into the bowl. Gently toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salmon cakes and salad between plates; top salmon cakes with yogurt. Enjoy!
